title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image from the context menu
summary: The control paths, registry references and roadmap details are supported. The briefing nevertheless labels licensing as mixed while saying the feature's entitlement is unpublished, and says Microsoft has not confirmed availability controls that the roadmap explicitly names.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft plans an Edge context-menu action that sends web images directly to Copilot.
claims.quote: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu

claims.claim: The planned image action lets users ask questions and gain insights without leaving their browsing experience.
claims.quote: making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience.

claims.claim: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext applies to Entra users using side-pane Copilot, including Business Chat and EDP experiences.
claims.quote: This policy applies only to users who are signed in to Microsoft Edge with a Microsoft Entra account and are using Copilot in the side pane. It applies to Copilot experiences in the side pane, including Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat and Microsoft Copilot with enterprise data protection (EDP).

claims.claim: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext does not apply to Microsoft-account profiles.
claims.quote: Applies to a profile that is signed in with a Microsoft account: No

claims.claim: The policy page says Copilot cannot access DLP-protected page content even when the policy is enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot can't access page content on pages protected by data loss prevention (DLP) policies, even if this policy is enabled.

claims.claim: Unconfigured side-pane context access is enabled by default in non-EU regions.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:

- Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions.

claims.claim: Unconfigured side-pane context access is disabled by default in EU regions.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:

- Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions.
- Access is disabled by default in EU regions.

claims.claim: Users can change side-pane context access in Edge settings when the policy is not configured.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:

- Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions.
- Access is disabled by default in EU regions.
- Users can turn this setting on or off in Microsoft Edge settings.
